properties.description: The class over the shapes a claim rests on a significant test in (the one step, a person-confirmed step, a chain through a lemma beside a taken-as-given premise, a statement with statement_kind): proof_status `supported`, reasoning_report truth `supported`, the reading naming α, p, the test and n, never shown or proven. A non-significant record reads `not_rejected` and the claim `unproven`. The record's assumptions are taken-as-given Constraints; an objection against one leaves the claim unknown and the step naming it. A significant test as an objection stands, never refutes. A block missing reject_h0 is refused by its path with nothing written. Real flo2-calc 0.10.0 records (Student's sleep data).
